title.orig: An Act Declaring December 27 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the City of Baybay, Province of Leyte, in Celebration of its “Binaybayon Festival”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11446_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: December 27 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the City of Baybay, Province of Leyte, in celebration of its "Binaybayon Festival". Upon proclamation of the President, December 27 of every year shall be a special nonworking holiday in the City of Baybay, Province of Leyte.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
